ai_summary: Akshar Spintex Limited announced the cessation of Mr. Parshotam L. Vasoya as an Independent Director, effective August 22, 2026, due to the completion of his existing tenure. The company will initiate the process to appoint a suitable replacement to maintain compliance with Board composition requirements. This appears to be a routine change in board structure with no apparent red flags or immediate negative material impact beyond the need for a new appointment.
